description: Angular component for configuring a polar area chart widget in the Thingsboard platform, extending a base chart configuration class and defining default data keys, settings, and UI controls.

classes.name: PolarAreaChartBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending LatestChartBasicConfigComponent to configure polar area chart widget with specific default data keys and settings.

methods.name: defaultDataKeys
methods.description: Provides default data keys for the chart, including windPower, solarPower, and hydroelectricPower.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Returns default settings for the polar area chart widget.

methods.name: latestChartConfigTemplate
methods.description: Returns the template reference for the latest chart configuration UI.

methods.name: setupLatestChartControls
methods.description: Sets up form controls for chart configuration options such as bar settings and axis parameters.

methods.name: prepareOutputLatestChartConfig
methods.description: Prepares and saves the chart configuration output based on form input.
